# taba_tokens (Data Source)

Lists the tokens, oldest first, without the secrets. Expired tokens are not listed. Needs authentication on and the root token or an `admin` token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The tokens whose name contains "ci", oldest first, without the secrets.
data "taba_tokens" "ci" {
  name_contains = "ci"
}

output "ci_token_ids" {
  value = data.taba_tokens.ci.ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_contains` (String) Only the tokens whose name contains this text.

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) The ids of the tokens found.
- `tokens` (Attributes List) The tokens found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tokens))

<a id="nestedatt--tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tokens`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation date (RFC 3339).
- `expires_at` (String) Deadline (RFC 3339), or null when the token does not expire.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the token.
- `name` (String) Name (not unique).
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permissions.
- `topic_prefixes` (Set of String) Prefixes the token is limited to (empty: every topic).
